name: Suuran Digit
source:
The private Soyogi Academy.

The sons and daughters of the nine noble households- referred to as the "Suuke (Number Families)"- attend this school. Within the school, these students are treated as superiors by their peers.

They have a secret- in this school, there is a war that only they’re able to fight in.

It is called the "Suuransen (Number War)".
Since the olden days, this periodically-fought war has been determining the rankings of the Suuke, as well as selecting a "Soyogi" who leads and controls the Suuke.

This war was thought to never take place again after one number broke away.

However, since the sudden re-emergence of “the number that should not exist”, the conditions for the Suuransen to be held have now been met…

“When the time comes in which the ten numbers assemble,
                             The carved seal shall guide you to the field of battle.”

Her name is Reisaki Hiroka.
She is the one who signals the beginning and the end.

[Translation of the [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/suran/story/]official website's story summary[/URL].]
translation:
私立苏阳学园。

九大名门的子女——被称为“数家”的人们——就读于此。在学校里，这些学生受到同学的敬畏与优待。

他们藏着一个秘密：学校里存在一场只有他们才能参与的战争。

这场战争称为“数战”。自古以来，定期举行的数战一直决定数家的排名，并选出领导、统治数家的“苏阳”。

曾有一个数字家族脱离，因此人们以为这场战争再也不会举行。

然而，随着“不该存在的数字”突然再度出现，举办数战的条件已经满足……

“当十个数字齐聚之时，
刻下的印记将指引你前往战场。”

她的名字是零崎广香。
她将宣告战争的开始与结束。

[译自[url=http://www.otomate.jp/suran/story/]官方网站故事简介[/url]]
